description: Template schema for runtime secrets. In cloud mode, these resolve to Secret Manager secrets.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini Pro / Flash API Key for Agent Swarm execution

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub Personal Access Token for repo telemetry and dispatch

VERCEL_TOKEN.description: Vercel API token for automated frontend previews and deployments

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Webhook endpoint for critical alerts and human approval notifications
